searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, sent-log.json (recent opportunity titles), applications.json (empty), and life/PIPELINE.md for exclusions (IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM). Checked life/PROFILE.md for the graduation-date conflict this run was told to watch for: both morning-briefing/profile.md and life/PROFILE.md now independently state December 2026 (settled 2026-08-04) -- no live conflict, both sides agree. WebSearch worked fine and surfaced live-looking new-grad FDE/APM postings (Domino Data Lab FDE New Grad 2026, Palantir FDSE New Grad). WebFetch was completely non-functional: every attempt returned EGRESS_BLOCKED (tested www.anthropic.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io). Direct curl to the same and to api.ashbyhq.com confirmed it's not a WebFetch-specific issue -- the proxy itself rejects the CONNECT with 'organization policy' before reaching any destination (recentRelayFailures list is empty because the block happens pre-relay). This is the identical failure first logged 2026-08-18/19 and reported on nearly every hunt run since (2026-08-20, 21, 23, 28, 29, 30, 31, and every day 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-11) -- now roughly a month of consecutive days with this exact blocker. hunt.md requires confirming eligibility and open status from the actual application page; a search snippet is explicitly disallowed as sole evidence, so the Domino/Palantir leads (and everything else) could not be verified and are correctly omitted. Zero verified opportunities is the honest output for the ~20th+ consecutive day; the blocker is an environment/org-level egress policy on outbound HTTPS, not a lack of findable roles, and has not self-resolved across a month of daily runs -- likely needs Dom or whoever administers this cloud environment's network policy to allowlist outbound job-board domains, since WebSearch alone cannot satisfy the verification rule this routine depends on.
